name: Digital Wallet
description: There are $$$N$$$ arrays, each array has $$$M$$$ positive integer elements The $$$j$$$-th element of the $$$i$$$-th array is $$$A_{i,j}$$$. Initially, Chaneka's digital wallet contains $$$0$$$ money. Given an integer $$$K$$$. Chaneka will do $$$M-K+1$$$ operations. In the $$$p$$$-th operation, Chaneka does the following procedure: Choose any array. Let's say Chaneka chooses the $$$x$$$-th array. Choose an index $$$y$$$ in that array such that $$$p \leq y \leq p+K-1$$$. Add the value of $$$A_{x, y}$$$ to the total money in the wallet. Change the value of $$$A_{x, y}$$$ into $$$0$$$. Determine the maximum total money that can be earned!
input_specification: The first line contains three integers $$$N$$$, $$$M$$$, and $$$K$$$ ($$$1 \leq N \leq 10$$$; $$$1 \leq M \leq 10^5$$$; $$$1 \leq K \leq \min(10, M)$$$) — the number of arrays, the size of each array, and the constant that describes the operation constraints. The $$$i$$$-th of the next $$$N$$$ lines contains $$$M$$$ integers $$$A_{i,1}, A_{i,2}, \ldots, A_{i,M}$$$ ($$$1 \leq A_{i,j} \leq 10^6$$$) — the elements of the $$$i$$$-th array.
output_specification: Output an integer representing the maximum total money that can be earned.
approach_summary: Express count as f(R) - f(L-1). Define memoized state dp[pos][tight][leading_zeros][cond] scanning digits from most to least significant in O(digits × base × states).

topic_editorial.title: Editorial: 1866D — Digital Wallet [439. Digit DP]
topic_editorial.summary: Digit DP counting values in range $[L, R]$.
topic_editorial.key_invariant: Counting valid integers in range $[L, R]$ can be decomposed into $f(R) - f(L-1)$, where $f(X)$ counts valid integers in $[0, X]$. Numbers $\le X$ can be formed digit-by-digit from the most significant position. The constraint that the prefix does not exceed $X$ is tracked by a single boolean flag `tight`.
